# Copilot Instructions for FRET

This file is a bridge only. **Do not add rules here.**

Shared engineering guidelines (method, writing, naming, Python/C++/CMake/
shell style) live in [.guidelines/](../.guidelines/), a git submodule. For
FRET's own project context and quality gates, read
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md). For FRET-specific coding notes, read
[docs/guidelines.md](../docs/guidelines.md).

Do not duplicate workflow rules in this file. If a request conflicts with
these documents, prioritize them unless the user explicitly asks to
change them.
